prompt: Seen from the back seat of a family hatchback at night: the driver's seat is empty, the seat belt hanging, the steering wheel turning slightly by itself as the car drives on its own along an empty motorway in a tight convoy of other driverless cars, all their headlights cold white. Far ahead on the horizon the silhouettes of giant walking cranes against an orange glow. A paper cup of water in the dashboard holder, still. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
